name: Graduate Program in Neuroscience (GPN) PhD
summary: Interdisciplinary Neuroscience doctoral research across molecular, cellular, systems, computational and behavioral fields.

publishedDeadlines.label: Domestic and international application
publishedDeadlines.note: No year stated. Program requests Summer entry in application and starts in lateJuly/August; site fall cycle is tracking only.

applicationFee.note: $75 U.S. citizens/permanent residents; $95 international. Central office does not waive fees, but GSDO offers targeted waivers for eligible U.S. citizens/permanent residents seeking a first graduate degree, with qualifying preparation/recruitment participation. Request before submission/payment. Medical School GPS domestic waiver also available; request by November20,2026 and before program deadline/payment.

english.note: IELTS writing/reading6.5; DET Fall2027 total/writing/reading120. Test within2years of program start. No TOEFL MyBest or IELTS One Skill Retake. Qualifying education exemptions depend country, credits, recency and physical attendance. Program specifically names TOEFL/IELTS; confirm other central alternatives and program new-scale minimum.

documents: Diversity of Views and Experiences statement (500 words)
requirements.note: Preferred undergraduateGPA3.0; no fixed course prerequisites. Prior research encouraged; biology, chemistry/biochemistry, psychology, math and physics useful. Top candidates visitFebruary and decisions follow. Select Summer term; admission model not explicitly confirmed by opened sources.

funding.note: All matriculated students fully supported throughout PhD if good standing/progress, including tuition and healthcare. Published rate$35.53/hour effectiveAugust25,2025 and95%healthcare coverage; confirm current rate. Firstyear program funding, then advisor.
